## Featured Flagship Projects
- **rerunner (PyPI Package v0.3.5)**: Deterministic flight recorder, $0 CI replay engine (<0.05s per replay), and time-travel debugger for AI agents. Features native Model Context Protocol (MCP) recording for Claude Code & Cursor, tamper-evident SHA-256 chains, official GitHub Action, and 114 tests passing at 100%. PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/rerunner/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/rerunner
- **Telco Customer Churn MLOps Platform**: Production-ready MLOps platform running DVC data versioning, MLflow model registry, Docker/Kubernetes container orchestration, and Jenkins CI/CD with AWS ECR. Tuned XGBoost model achieves **0.847 ROC-AUC**, raising recall from **52.7% → 75.1% (+42.6% relative gain)** with **10 ms P50 latency** under 25K requests. Live Demo: https://telco-churn-mlops.streamlit.app/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/telco-churn-mlops
- **TN Government AI Scheme Assistant (TNGov-AI-Assistant)**: Production bilingual (English/Tamil) hybrid RAG assistant (BM25 + ChromaDB with reciprocal rank fusion) querying 37 welfare schemes with source citations. Achieved **40/40 Hit@5**, **0.963 MRR**, 86 unit tests, and passed a 50-query benchmark with a 6-model fallback guardrail. Live Demo: https://tn-gov-ai-assistant.vercel.app/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/TNGov-AI-Assistant
- **Autonomous Data Analyst (ADA)**: Production 7-agent autonomous tabular intelligence and AutoML system delivering **100% verified numerical grounding**, zero arbitrary code execution, automated executive PDF/PPTX reports in under 25s, and a **590-test suite passing at 100%**. Live Cloud Demo: https://autonomous--data--analyst.streamlit.app/ | Repository: https://github.com/aakash1552005/Autonomous-Data-Analyst

## Professional Experience
- **AI & Embedded Systems Intern** at **AICTE IDEA Lab, Vel Tech University** (May 2026 – Jul 2026): Built a cloud child-malnutrition tracking platform (Next.js, Supabase, Flask) with a soft-voting ensemble (XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest) reaching 86.4% risk accuracy, 70% recall on high-risk cases, and 0% failures under 500 requests/s load testing. Developed an AI waste-sorting system for Greater Chennai Corporation using MobileNetV2 (97.76% validation accuracy) with ESP32-CAM and moisture-sensor fallback below 60% confidence.

Built a real-time CNN face-mask detector (OpenCV, Keras) achieving 92.3% test accuracy on live video streams, and engineered an SMS spam classifier across 5,572 messages using TF-IDF and SVM to reach 98% accuracy.
